response.sql:
WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(rfistat, '(no status)') AS status,
    AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat, '(no status)')
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT status, avg_modindex
  FROM status_averages
  WHERE avg_modindex > (SELECT AVG(modindex) FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT
  status,
  avg_modindex,
  avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(modindex) FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL) AS above_overall_average,
  avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM above_overall) AS difference_from_qualifying_status_mean
FROM above_overall;

assumptions.assumption: “Above-average” means each status group's mean modulation index is greater than the overall mean across signals with a non-NULL modulation index; the comparison mean of qualifying statuses is the unweighted mean of their group averages. The displayed label “(no status)” represents NULL RFI statuses.
